turns.text:
ok wait boss can you make this less weird lol. writing late after my friday commissary block, fried a whole batch for the market so my hands smell like oil 🥢

draft: "hey linh, sorry to lean on you AGAIN lol. thank you so much for the shared spreadsheet with the ingredients, kitchen hours and sales tabs, it's literally the only reason i know what anything costs. so i have a sunday stall at delgado park now, row C near the bandstand, and i'm gonna be slammed. would you want to help me work it? i'd pay you obviously. no pressure at all, i know you're busy, sorry again"

Nice work getting a full batch done tonight! Your draft is warm already. The main thing making it feel awkward is the stacked apologies, so I trimmed those and made the ask and the pay clear. Here's a version:

"Hey Linh! Thank you again for the shared spreadsheet with the ingredients, kitchen hours and sales tabs. It's made everything so much easier to track. I have a Sunday stall at Delgado Park now, row C near the bandstand, and I could really use another pair of hands. Would you want to work it with me? I'd pay you for your time, and we can sort out the rate and hours together. Totally fine if it doesn't work, just let me know either way. No rush!"

A few notes:
- I kept the thank-you but cut the "sorry again" bits, so it reads as an offer instead of a favor.
- Naming the pay up front keeps it professional, which helps it not feel weird at work.
- If you want it even lighter, I can shorten it to three sentences.
ok actually can you make it friendlier, like add a little joke? and keep it short, i'm falling asleep

Sure, here's a shorter, friendlier one:

"Hey Linh! Thanks again for the shared spreadsheet with the ingredients, kitchen hours and sales tabs. It's saved me. I've got a Sunday stall at Delgado Park, row C near the bandstand, and I'd love to hire you for market days. Paid, of course. The job involves lumpia and bossing me around a little. Let me know what you think, no pressure!"

If you'd like, I can add a line about the rate once you've decided on it, like [your rate]. Get some sleep!
sige thanks that helps a ton 🔥
Anytime! Good luck with the stall, and I hope she says yes.
